title: Make long-running agents faster with message threads
summary: Message threads are now in public beta in the Messages API on Claude Platform, AWS, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud. Clients add a thread parameter so later requests send only new messages plus the previous response ID, and in Claude Code (where threads are on by default) median time to first token fell about 35% for 500k-1M token requests. Threads expire 5 minutes after the last request, while token usage, standard rates, and rate limits are unchanged.

title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Anthropic introduced ready-to-use interactive legal artifacts, such as trackers and dashboards that teams can adapt to their own data, including a legal gallery for cite checking, contract review, and regulatory change tracking. Partner-contributed artifacts from Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner, and PwC are included alongside nine access-to-justice artifacts, and 60+ legal connectors such as Bloomberg Law and Filevine link outputs back to sources. The launch also starts a Legal Ambassadors Program (waitlist) and funds access-to-justice groups.

title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
summary: Claude for Nonprofits adds a plugin of skills and connectors built with about 30 nonprofits, covering small-team work, org-context setup with AI policy checks, and fundraising through grant reporting. Anthropic also plans to extend Claude Corps through a Taproot partnership that matches nonprofits with pro bono consultants. The plugin installs automatically at no extra cost on Team and Enterprise plans, and 25,000+ nonprofits already use Claude, with over 75% of them having fewer than 10 seats.

title: How to manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
summary: This best-practices guide explains how to govern Claude Code spend on Google Cloud using three levers: control, track, and prove. The Claude apps gateway provides spend caps, model allowlists, and alerts at 75% and 95%, while Google Cloud budgets, BigQuery exports, and Cloud Monitoring handle tracking. It recommends measuring adoption, satisfaction, and PR cycle time against a baseline, and starting with defaults before refining limits by role and team.

title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop
summary: Anthropic offers guidance on replacing orchestrator-plus-subagent designs with a single agent loop that uses one model and one context, loading knowledge and tools on demand through skills and tool search. The suggested staged migration is to build an end-to-end eval, merge coupled specialists, convert subagents to tools, then fold them into skills. Anthropic reports a single agent with skills often beats subagent designs on quality, cost, and latency (one customer saw about a 2x speedup), while subagents still fit context bloat, parallel tasks, and tool-selection conflicts, and a migration kit and API skills were introduced.

title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
summary: Three Claude Enterprise features are now generally available: smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets. Smart reports sample a team's transcripts, group work into workstreams, and show spend, deliverables, friction points, and skill recommendations, but are not meant for evaluating individuals. Pooled budgets give a team a shared monthly budget with individual limits as guardrails and alerts at 50, 75, 95, and 100%, helping admins see where Claude creates value and avoid unused budget.
